text: Good quality medicine at affordable prices, and open 24 hours. Excellent and attentive customer service.

The first night, I went to the pharmacy to buy medicine for a cough and sore throat.
The pharmacist gave me Reparil-Dragees 20mg.

I took one tablet and then looked up more information. It turns out it's a decongestant.

The next day, I jokingly asked the staff if I could buy this medicine for a cough and sore throat. The staff said, "This medicine doesn't treat coughs." I asked again, and they insisted it didn't.

I then showed the medicine I bought to the staff and asked why they gave me this medicine. The packaging clearly states it's for reducing cough and sore throat symptoms. The staff said that if I had a sore throat, I could take it, and suggested I buy cough medicine separately.

My question is: Why didn't the pharmacy give me cough medicine the night before? Why did they give me a decongestant with the label saying "reducing cough and sore throat symptoms"?
This store is good, the service is consistent. You can buy medicine here when needed.
